description: Labelled triage set for decision-model calibration (ADR-0024). Each item is a real sentence pattern from NZ political text with a hand-assigned speakership class (ADR-0025 axis 1) and, where the sentence is eligible, a content class (axis 2). The decision port is calibrated against these labels; the gate is n>=20 per class. `arguable: true` marks an item whose label a careful second annotator could dispute — those are reported separately so they do not flatter the accuracy figure.

provenance.sources: Sentences drawn from the RNZ political article used in the live slice, the repo's triage fixtures, and NZ political reportage patterns.
provenance.note: A labelled set is a published artefact: it is never hand-edited after a run, and a relabel is a new version with a new measurement behind it.
